name: Laopu Gold Co., Ltd.
summary: Laopu Gold Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells jewelry products in Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Macau. It offers handmade goldware, including pendants, bracelets, rings, earrings, jewelry for babies, and gem-set jewelry, as well as gold antiques and collectibles. The company also provides maintenance and repair services for jewelry products. It sells its products through stores and online. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.
